usedFor: Bluesky holds your posts, and Hastewire rewrites their text through “Humanize Text” so it sounds natural.

bestTemplate.name: “New Posts by Author” in Bluesky, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: Each new post from the chosen author arrives as text that Hastewire can rewrite to sound natural.

watchOut: “New Posts by Author” in Bluesky is polling, so rewrites follow a scheduled check rather than the post itself.
